notes:
LOANWORD:
From English 'delivery.'

JAPANESE EQUIVALENTS:
- ⟦{配達|はいたつ}→配達：00084_haitatsu⟧ (delivery - general term)
- ⟦{出前|でまえ}→出前：08155_demae⟧ (food delivery - traditional term)

REGISTER:
Neutral to casual. Very common in modern Japanese, especially for food delivery.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- デリバリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{頼|たの}む→頼む：01104_tanomu⟧ (to order delivery)
- デリバリー⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧ (delivery service)
- ⟦フード→フード：28535_fuudo⟧デリバリー (food delivery)
- デリバリー⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧ (delivery-only)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Food delivery apps like Uber Eats and ⟦{出前館|でまえかん}→出前館：noentry⟧ have made デリバリー extremely popular in Japan. The COVID-19 pandemic further accelerated this trend.
